## Method:

**4) Tiered boarding** First class boards in their section, business class boards in their section, economy boards in their section

## Planning:

**4) Tiered Boarding** 72 passengers board a plane with 12 rows and 6 columns. There's one aisle down the middle of the plane. The 72 passengers are split into three groups: first class, business class, and economy. First class passengers board their section (rows 1 and 2). Business class passengers board their section (rows 3-5). Economy passengers board their section (rows 6-12). There are no assigned seats. The constraints are just that the groups enter in order, and each person in each group sits in a random, unoccupied seat of their section.
